description: Returns clinical trials recruiting now for a condition, from ClinicalTrials.gov: title, phase, sponsor, who can join (age, sex, healthy volunteers), the nearest recruiting site and its distance, and the study page. A city and state or ZIP code searches within a radius. An age keeps only trials that accept that age. Applies to questions about which clinical trials are recruiting for a condition. Not medical advice. A medicine label, a recall report and a pharmacy price are outside this result.

condition.description: Condition, e.g. 'type 1 diabetes', 'early-stage triple negative breast cancer'

intervention.description: A drug or treatment to narrow to, e.g. 'pembrolizumab'

place.description: A city and state or ZIP code, e.g. 'Boston, MA' or '02108'.

name: check_trials
title: Trials: recruiting clinical trials for a condition
